caption: The drawing features a shield-shaped object located centrally within a thin, square, gold-bordered frame on an off-white background. The shield is decorated with alternating vertical red and white stripes, with the white areas filled with a pattern of small blue marks. A horizontal red band crosses the top portion of the shield. Above the shield, two ribbon-like shapes curve across the top, one in red and the other in blue, each attached to a circular loop in the opposite color at each end. In the upper section of the shield, there is some cursive writing in red. In each of the lower corners inside the square border, there is a blue circular ring with a red ribbon-like shape passing through it and extending downward. The overall color scheme consists of red, blue, white, and gold.
title: Quilt (One Square)
